title: Bayesian $\kappa$-Explorer for Minimax Model Estimation in MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study active exploration for minimax transition estimation in unknown Markov decision processes (MDPs). Frequentist $\kappa$-Explorer~\citep{gu2026kappa} addresses this problem through a parameterized family of exploration objectives, but requires confidence-bound constructions and joint optimization over plausible transition kernels and occupancy measures, introducing a computational burden that limits its practical applicability. We develop Bayesian $\kappa$-Explorer, which simplifies this procedure by placing Dirichlet priors on the transition distributions. Under the posterior mean estimator, the posterior expected squared $\ell_2$ error equals the total posterior variance, providing a closed-form exploration signal. The algorithm plans under the posterior mean model, eliminating confidence-set optimization. translated_title: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中用于极小极大模型估计的贝叶斯 κ-Explorer
translated_abstract: 我们研究了未知马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中用于极小极大转移估计的主动探索问题。频率学派的 κ-Explorer 通过一族参数化的探索目标来解决这一问题，但其需要构建置信界，并对可行的转移核与占用测度进行联合优化，由此带来的计算负担限制了其实际适用性。我们提出了贝叶斯 κ-Explorer，通过在转移分布上放置狄利克雷先验来简化这一过程。在后验均值估计量下，后验期望平方 ℓ₂ 误差等于总后验方差，从而提供了一个闭式（closed-form）的探索信号。该算法在后验均值模型下进行规划，从而免除了置信集优化。在所陈述的假设下，这一更简单的规划过程仍能保持 Õ(T^(-1/3)) 的代理收敛率。
tldr: 该论文提出贝叶斯 κ-Explorer，通过在转移分布上放置狄利克雷先验并基于后验均值模型进行规划，以闭式探索信号简化了 MDP 中极小极大转移估计的主动探索，在免除置信集优化的同时仍保持 Õ(T^(-1/3)) 的收敛率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bayesian κ-Explorer, which simplifies active exploration for minimax transition estimation in MDPs by placing Dirichlet priors on transition distributions and planning under the posterior mean model, yielding a closed-form exploration signal that retains the Õ(T^(-1/3)) convergence rate while eliminating confidence-set optimization.
